question: A thin semicircular conducting wire of radius $R$ lies in the $xy$-plane with its diameter along the $x$-axis from $(-R,0)$ to $(+R,0)$. A uniform magnetic field $\vec B = B\,\hat{k}$ is applied (along $+z$ direction). A steady current $I$ flows along the semicircular arc from $(-R,0)$ to $(+R,0)$. Find the magnitude of the net magnetic force on the semicircular wire.
